name: Quaker Plain Salted Puffed Rice Cakes
whyItWorks: Puffed white rice cakes are ultra-light, naturally gluten-free, and practically dissolve on contact with saliva. With zero fat and minimal fiber (0.5g), they provide clean, non-irritating calories.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat plain as a crunchy flare snack, or spread lightly with smooth creamy peanut butter or seedless jelly.
watchOuts: Avoid multi-seed or multigrain rice cakes with whole sesame or flax seeds.
